Has it ben fixed? Nah, that would be, like, reasonable and intelligent.
Instead, WotC decided to sweep the worst errors and problems in Jyhad under
the rug, and forget they ever existed (thus never dealing with them.)
Concealed Weapon, Rotschreck, and a few other obvious errors were just removed
from the cardmix entirely. <sounds of booing and general displeasure>
At least they changed Blood Rage.
